note: The single registry of aadhar.sh's public routable surfaces. Authored by hand. scripts/gen-manifest.mjs derives the shell/sitemap/agent projections from it (npm run gen:manifest), and build.mjs invariant #8 fails the deploy on drift. Leaf content that already has its own registry is deliberately NOT duplicated here: writing posts live in holding/writing/posts.json, photos in holding/images/manifest.json, resume artifacts are static files. Flags map to one surface each so drift is checkable: run=nav.js PAGES (Run palette), taskbar=nav.js SUBPAGES (pinned apps), sitemap=sitemap.xml <loc>, gallery=holding/garage/index.html shelf, agents=MCP resources/list projection, webmention=accepts an inbound Webmention (a section so flagged also vouches for its leaf posts in posts.json); searchIndex=generate-search-index.mjs manual injection (for worker-rendered pages the source-tree walk cannot see; static pages are auto-indexed regardless).
